findings.location: HTML, stanza beginning “Then, a rich voice…”
findings.source_quote: Then, a rich voice spoke inside me,
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Kisha sauti yenye utajiri ikasema ndani yangu,” with “Kisha sauti yenye mamlaka ikasema ndani yangu,” to convey a voice rich in quality or depth, not material wealth.
findings.translation_quote: Kisha sauti yenye utajiri ikasema ndani yangu,

findings.location: HTML, stanza beginning “But I saw that your heart needed different…”
findings.source_quote: But I saw that your heart needed different / Than the way that ease had preferred.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the two lines with “Lakini niliona kwamba moyo wako ulihitaji kitu tofauti / na kile ambacho maisha ya raha yangependelea.” The current wording shifts the contrast to “easy life” and leaves the comparison unclear.
findings.translation_quote: Lakini niliona moyo wako ulihitaji kitu tofauti / Na kile ambacho maisha mepesi yangependelea.

findings.location: HTML, stanza beginning “I pray that my heart would be yielded…”
findings.source_quote: Allowing His will to change me,
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Nikiruhusu mapenzi yake yanibadilishe,” with “Nikiacha mapenzi yake yanibadilishe,” to preserve the sense of yielding to and allowing the Master’s will to change the speaker.

findings.source_quote: If He rules the inmost being, / Then nothing outside will disturb.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Akitawala utu wa ndani kabisa, / Basi hakuna kitu cha nje kitakachotusumbua.” with “Akitawala utu wa ndani kabisa, / basi hakuna kitu cha nje kitakachonisumbua.” The source speaks about the individual speaker, not “us.”
findings.translation_quote: Akitawala utu wa ndani kabisa, / Basi hakuna kitu cha nje kitakachotusumbua.
